sources.name: indicvoices
sources.access_detail: HF gated:auto. UNBLOCKED 2026-08-11: founder account accepted the terms; read token present on this machine (never committed). Ingest via the `ingest-hf` preset with the token discovered from the environment/HF token file.
sources.notes: APPROVED PRIMARY eval source (+ future train backbone); spontaneous-heavy. Schema verified 2026-08-11: speaker_id, verbatim/normalized transcripts, scenario/gender/age/district. hindi/valid = 5,530 rows (~518 MB); hindi/train = 445,160 rows (~49 GB, NOT ingested — 15D concern).

speaker_disjointness: Per-clip speaker ids present for every clip; the frozen eval's 32-speaker roster is mechanically excluded; content-hash disjointness enforced besides. Same admission policy as qwen-hi-public-train@v2, window inverted to [0.5s, 2.0s).
curation: deterministic: ascending sha256 order first 800 accepted clips (row-count budget); eval disjointness enforced by content hash against stt-hi-public-eval@v1 and by speaker roster (32 speakers); admission window inverted to the short-speech slice [0.5s, 2.0s)
